cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may hold my wedding bouquet a moment. Just pinch the stems while I sort this sliding ribbon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got them. Can we use wire underneath?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wire is approved. Could you just twist this bit where your fingers are?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. The end will snag the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may tuck it in, then just wind the ribbon over it. One little bow is authorized. I'll supervise the scissors.

reason: Make each useful contribution into permission for one more tiny finishing favor, leaving A with supervision while B quietly completes the bouquet.
